translations.literal: General Storage controlled receipts and disbursements for the six storehouses; the weaving offices and dyeing bureau were subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: General Storage controlled receipts and disbursements for the six storehouses, with the weaving offices and the dyeing bureau subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 會稽掌本府出納，凡果園地畝、戶口徭役，歲終會覈以聞。

translations.literal: Accounts controlled the department's receipts and disbursements; all orchard lands, household registers, and corvée duties were audited at year's end and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts managed the department's receipts and disbursements, audited orchard lands, household registers, and corvée duties at year's end, and reported the results.

sentences.zh: 掌禮掌本府祭祀與其禮儀樂舞，兼稽太監品級，果園賦稅。

translations.literal: Ceremonies controlled the department's sacrifices and their ritual music and dance, and also audited eunuch ranks and orchard taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonies oversaw the department's sacrifices and their ritual music and dance, and also audited eunuch ranks and orchard taxes.

sentences.zh: 都虞掌武職銓選，稽覈俸饟恩血阜，珠軒歲納，佃漁歲輸，並定其額以供。

translations.literal: Household Affairs controlled military appointments and selections, audited salaries, rations, and compassionate grants, annual tribute from the Pearl Office, and annual payments from tenant farming and fisheries, fixing quotas for supply.
translations.idiomatic: Household Affairs managed military appointments, audited salaries, rations, and relief grants, supervised annual tribute from the Pearl Office and annual payments from tenant farming and fisheries, and fixed the quotas for supply.

sentences.zh: 慎刑掌本府刑名，依律擬罪，重讞移三法司會訊題結；

translations.literal: Punishments controlled the department's criminal cases, determined penalties according to law, and referred major cases to the Three Judicial Offices for joint interrogation and memorialized conclusion;
translations.idiomatic: Punishments handled the department's criminal cases, determined penalties according to law, and referred major cases to the Three Judicial Offices for joint interrogation and final memorialized ruling;

sentences.zh: 番役處隸之。

translations.literal: the Banner Service Office was subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: the Banner Service Office was subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 營造掌本府繕修，庀材飭工，帥六庫三作以供令。

translations.literal: Construction controlled the department's repairs, prepared materials and directed workers, and led the six storehouses and three workshops to carry out orders.
translations.idiomatic: Construction oversaw the department's repairs, prepared materials, directed workers, and led the six storehouses and three workshops in carrying out orders.

sentences.zh: 慶豐掌牛羊群牧，嘉薦犧牲。

translations.literal: Celebratory Abundance controlled the cattle and sheep herds and provided fine sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: Celebratory Abundance managed the cattle and sheep herds and supplied fine sacrificial victims.

sentences.zh: 錢糧衙門掌三旗莊賦，治其賞罰與其優血阜。

translations.literal: The Grain and Funds Office controlled the estate levies of the Three Banners and administered their rewards, punishments, and preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Grain and Funds Office managed the estate levies of the Three Banners and administered their rewards, punishments, and preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 內管領處掌承應中宮差務，並稽官三倉物用、恩豐倉餼米。

translations.literal: The Interior Steward Office attended to duties assigned by the empress and audited supplies from the Official Three Granaries and grain rations from the Enfeng Granary.
translations.idiomatic: The Interior Steward Office handled duties assigned by the empress and audited supplies from the Official Three Granaries and grain rations from the Enfeng Granary.

sentences.zh: 官房租庫掌收房稅。

translations.literal: The Official Rent Storehouse collected house rents.
translations.idiomatic: The Official Rent Storehouse collected house rents.

sentences.zh: 養心殿造辦處掌製造器用。

translations.literal: The Hall of Mental Cultivation Manufacturing Office controlled the manufacture of utensils.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Mental Cultivation Manufacturing Office oversaw the manufacture of utensils.

sentences.zh: 中正殿各司員掌喇嘛唪經。

translations.literal: The secretaries of the Hall of Central Correctness controlled Lama sutra chanting.
translations.idiomatic: The secretaries of the Hall of Central Correctness supervised Lama sutra chanting.

sentences.zh: 武英殿修書處掌監刊書籍。

translations.literal: The Wuying Hall Book Repair Office supervised the printing of books.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuying Hall Book Repair Office supervised the printing of books.

sentences.zh: 雍和、寧壽兩宮司員掌陳設氾埽，兼稽宮監勤惰。

translations.literal: The secretaries of the Yonghe and Ningshou palaces controlled furnishings and sweeping, and also audited the diligence and idleness of palace eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: The secretaries of the Yonghe and Ningshou palaces managed furnishings and cleaning, and also audited the diligence of palace eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 御書處掌鐫摹御書。

translations.literal: The Imperial Calligraphy Office controlled the carving and copying of imperial calligraphy.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Calligraphy Office oversaw the carving and copying of imperial calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 御茶膳房掌供飲食。

translations.literal: The Imperial Tea and Provisions Office supplied food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Tea and Provisions Office supplied food and drink.

sentences.zh: 御藥房掌合丸散。

translations.literal: The Imperial Pharmacy compounded pills and powders.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Pharmacy compounded pills and powders.

sentences.zh: 犧牲所掌牧養黝牛。

translations.literal: The Sacrificial Victims Office raised and kept black cattle.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacrificial Victims Office raised black cattle for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 總理工程處掌行營工作。

translations.literal: The General Works Office controlled traveling-palace construction work.
translations.idiomatic: The General Works Office managed construction work at the traveling palaces.

sentences.zh: 凡遇工程，簡勘估大臣、承修大臣，事畢簡查驗大臣。

translations.literal: Whenever a project arose, survey-and-estimate grand ministers and construction grand ministers were selected; when finished, inspection grand ministers were selected.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a project arose, grand ministers were selected to survey and estimate the work and to oversee construction; when the work was finished, grand ministers were selected to inspect it.

sentences.zh: 初制，設內務府，以舊屬司其事。

translations.literal: Under the original regulation the Imperial Household Department was established, with former subordinates managing its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original regulations the Imperial Household Department was established, with former subordinates managing its affairs.

sentences.zh: 入關後，明三十二衛人附之，設內管領處，置內管領八人。

translations.literal: After entering the pass, personnel from the Ming Thirty-two Guards were attached; the Interior Steward Office was established with eight interior stewards.
translations.idiomatic: After the conquest, personnel from the Ming Thirty-two Guards were attached, and the Interior Steward Office was established with eight interior stewards.

sentences.zh: 順治三年增四人，十一年增八人，分隸三旗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi four were added, in the eleventh year eight were added, and they were distributed among the Three Banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shunzhi four were added, in the eleventh year eight more were added, and they were distributed among the Three Banners.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十四年增四人，三十年增三人，三十四年增三人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Kangxi four were added, in the thirtieth year three, and in the thirty-fourth year three.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Kangxi four were added, in the thirtieth year three more, and in the thirty-fourth year three more.

sentences.zh: 設茶飯處，置總領各三人，飯上人三十有五人，茶上人十有七人，康熙二十年置飯上人委署總領一人。

translations.literal: The Tea and Food Office was established with three chiefs each, thirty-five senior provision stewards, seventeen senior tea stewards, and in the twentieth year of Kangxi one acting chief among the senior provision stewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Tea and Food Office was established with three chiefs each, thirty-five senior provision stewards, and seventeen senior tea stewards; in the twentieth year of Kangxi one acting chief was added among the senior provision stewards.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年定總領授二等侍衛；

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng it was fixed that chiefs should be granted second-class bodyguard rank;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng it was fixed that chiefs should receive second-class bodyguard rank;

sentences.zh: 飯上人授三等侍衛六人，藍翎侍衛七人；

translations.literal: six senior provision stewards were granted third-class bodyguard rank and seven blue-plume bodyguard rank;
translations.idiomatic: six senior provision stewards received third-class bodyguard rank and seven received blue-plume bodyguard rank;

sentences.zh: 茶上人三等侍衛三人，藍翎侍衛四人；

translations.literal: three senior tea stewards third-class bodyguard rank and four blue-plume bodyguards;
translations.idiomatic: three senior tea stewards received third-class bodyguard rank and four received blue-plume bodyguard rank;

sentences.zh: 復置茶房侍衛內委署總領一人。

translations.literal: one acting chief was again established among the tea-room bodyguards.
translations.idiomatic: and one acting chief was again established among the tea-room bodyguards.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年定三等侍衛內各授一等侍衛一人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong it was fixed that within each third-class bodyguard group one should be granted first-class bodyguard rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qianlong it was fixed that within each third-class bodyguard group one holder should receive first-class bodyguard rank.

sentences.zh: 十五年改飯房為外膳房。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the provision kitchen was renamed the Outer Provisions Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the provision kitchen was renamed the Outer Provisions Office.

sentences.zh: 二十四年改總領為尚膳正、尚茶正，副總領為尚膳副、尚茶副。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year chiefs were renamed chief provision stewards and chief tea stewards, and deputy chiefs deputy provision stewards and deputy tea stewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year chiefs were renamed chief provision stewards and chief tea stewards, and deputy chiefs were renamed deputy provision stewards and deputy tea stewards.

sentences.zh: 承應長十人，康熙六十一年增一人。

translations.literal: Ten service chiefs; in the sixty-first year of Kangxi one was added.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten service chiefs; in the sixty-first year of Kangxi one more was added.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年增一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng one more was added.

sentences.zh: 庖長三人，康熙五十六年增六人，六十一年增一人。

translations.literal: Three kitchen chiefs; in the fifty-sixth year of Kangxi six were added, and in the sixty-first year one.
translations.idiomatic: There were three kitchen chiefs; in the fifty-sixth year of Kangxi six more were added, and in the sixty-first year one more.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年增二人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng two were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng two more were added.

sentences.zh: 及蘇州、江寧、杭州織造官。

translations.literal: as well as weaving officials at Suzhou, Jiangning, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There were also weaving officials at Suzhou, Jiangning, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年省江寧一人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu the Jiangning post was reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu the Jiangning post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 順治十一年，命工部立十三衙門，設司禮、御用、御馬、內官、尚衣、尚膳、尚寶、司設八監，尚方、惜薪、鐘鼓三司，兵仗、織染二局；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi the Ministry of Works was ordered to establish thirteen offices: eight directorates—Rites, Imperial Use, Imperial Horses, Inner Palace, Imperial Garments, Imperial Provisions, Imperial Seals, and Equipment—and three bureaus—Imperial Manufactures, Firewood, and Bells and Drums—and two workshops—Arms and Weaving and Dyeing;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi the Ministry of Works was ordered to establish thirteen offices: eight directorates—Rites, Imperial Use, Imperial Horses, Inner Palace, Imperial Garments, Imperial Provisions, Imperial Seals, and Equipment—and three bureaus—Imperial Manufactures, Firewood, and Bells and Drums—and two workshops—Arms and Weaving and Dyeing;

sentences.zh: 並三旗牛羊群牧處，置員外郎六人。

translations.literal: together with the Three Banners Cattle and Sheep Herds Office, with six vice directors appointed.
translations.idiomatic: together with the Three Banners Cattle and Sheep Herds Office, for which six vice directors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 管理牛只、羊只各三人。

translations.literal: Three to manage cattle and three to manage sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Three officials managed cattle and three managed sheep.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年各增二人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi two were added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi two more were added to each group.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年省入寧壽宮一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one was transferred to the Palace of Tranquil Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one post was transferred to the Palace of Tranquil Longevity.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年省入慎刑司二人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng two were transferred to the Bureau of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng two posts were transferred to the Bureau of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年省一人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 明年，改尚方司為院，置郎中三人，康熙三十一年省一人。

translations.literal: The next year the Imperial Manufactures Bureau was changed to an office; three directors were appointed, and in the thirty-first year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Imperial Manufactures Bureau was elevated to an office with three directors; in the thirty-first year of Kangxi one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 員外郎六人，康熙三十八年省一人，六十一年省一人。

translations.literal: Six vice directors; in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi one was abolished, and in the sixty-first year one.
translations.idiomatic: There were six vice directors; in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi one was abolished, and in the sixty-first year another.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年省四人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu four were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu four posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 催總一人。

translations.literal: One supervising chief.
translations.idiomatic: There was one supervising chief.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年增一人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng one more was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年更名催長。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong the title was changed to supervising clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong the title was changed to supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 下同。

translations.literal: The same below.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies below.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改鐘鼓司為禮儀監，尚寶監為司。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Bells and Drums Bureau was changed to the Rites Directorate, and the Imperial Seals Directorate to a bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the Bells and Drums Bureau was renamed the Rites Directorate, and the Imperial Seals Directorate was reduced to a bureau.

sentences.zh: 時猶舊臣、寺臣兼用也。

translations.literal: At the time former Ming officials and temple officials were still used together.
translations.idiomatic: At the time former Ming officials and temple officials were still employed side by side.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改禮儀監為院，置郎中三人，康熙三十八年省一人。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Rites Directorate was changed to an office; three directors were appointed, and in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the Rites Directorate was elevated to an office with three directors; in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 員外郎八人，光緒三十年省一人。

translations.literal: Eight vice directors; in the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight vice directors; in the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.

sentences.zh: 贊禮郎十有二人，雍正五年增五人。

translations.literal: Twelve ritual announcers; in the fifth year of Yongzheng five were added.
translations.idiomatic: There were twelve ritual announcers; in the fifth year of Yongzheng five more were added.

sentences.zh: 司胙官四人，康熙三十七年增一人。

translations.literal: Four sacrificial-meat officers; in the thirty-seventh year of Kangxi one was added.
translations.idiomatic: There were four sacrificial-meat officers; in the thirty-seventh year of Kangxi one more was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年改「胙」為「俎」。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong the character for "sacrificial flesh" was changed to that for "sacrificial stand."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong the title was changed from sacrificial-flesh officer to sacrificial-stand officer.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年省一人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 喇嘛唪經處催總一人。

translations.literal: One supervising chief for the Lama Sutra Chanting Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Lama Sutra Chanting Office had one supervising chief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十三省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirty-third year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in the thirty-third year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 改內官監為宣徽院，置郎中三人，康熙二十八年省一人。

translations.literal: The Inner Palace Directorate was changed to the Xuanhui Office; three directors were appointed, and in the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Palace Directorate was renamed the Xuanhui Office with three directors; in the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年增一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng one more was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十年改隸寧壽宮一人。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year of Qianlong one was transferred to the Palace of Tranquil Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year of Qianlong one post was transferred to the Palace of Tranquil Longevity.

sentences.zh: 員外郎六人，光緒三十年省一人。

translations.literal: Six vice directors; in the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were six vice directors; in the thirtieth year of Guangxu one was abolished.

sentences.zh: 催總八人。

translations.literal: Eight supervising chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight supervising chiefs.

sentences.zh: 康熙間屢有增損。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign there were repeated additions and reductions.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi reign the numbers were repeatedly increased and reduced.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十一年定留頂戴催長五人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Jiaqing it was fixed to retain five supervising clerks with official finials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Jiaqing it was fixed to retain five supervising clerks with official finials.

sentences.zh: 十八年，御用監設銀、皮、緞、衣四庫，置郎中三人，員外郎八人，庫使四十人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Imperial Use Directorate established four storehouses—silver, hides, silk, and garments—with three directors, eight vice directors, and forty storehouse attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Imperial Use Directorate established four storehouses—silver, hides, silk, and garments—with three directors, eight vice directors, and forty storehouse attendants.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年增二十人，十四年增二十有四人，明年省四人，二十八年增十有二人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi twenty were added, in the fourteenth year twenty-four, the next year four were abolished, and in the twenty-eighth year twelve were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Kangxi twenty were added, in the fourteenth year twenty-four more, the next year four were cut, and in the twenty-eighth year twelve more were added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年升十二人為副司庫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong twelve were promoted to assistant storehouse superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong twelve attendants were promoted to assistant storehouse superintendents.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，誅內監吳良輔輩，復以三旗包衣設內務府，改尚膳監為采捕衙門，置郎中三人，三十八年省一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi the eunuchs Wu Liangfu and his associates were executed; the Imperial Household Department was re-established with banner bondservants of the Three Banners; the Imperial Provisions Directorate was changed to the Hunting and Fishing Office with three directors, and in the thirty-eighth year one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi the eunuchs Wu Liangfu and his associates were executed; the Imperial Household Department was re-established using bondservants of the Three Banners; the Imperial Provisions Directorate became the Hunting and Fishing Office with three directors, and in the thirty-eighth year one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 員外郎六人，六十一年省一人。

translations.literal: Six vice directors; in the sixty-first year one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were six vice directors; in the sixty-first year one was abolished.

sentences.zh: 催總四人。

translations.literal: Four supervising chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: There were four supervising chiefs.

sentences.zh: 並改惜薪司為內工部，置郎中三人，三十八年省一人。

translations.literal: The Firewood Bureau was also changed to the Inner Works Department with three directors, and in the thirty-eighth year one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Firewood Bureau was also renamed the Inner Works Department with three directors; in the thirty-eighth year one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 員外郎六人，十六年增二人。

translations.literal: Six vice directors; in the sixteenth year two were added.
translations.idiomatic: There were six vice directors; in the sixteenth year two more were added.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年省二人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 無品級庫掌十有二人，三十五年增二人。

translations.literal: Twelve storehouse chiefs without official rank; in the thirty-fifth year two were added.
translations.idiomatic: There were twelve storehouse chiefs without official rank; in the thirty-fifth year two more were added.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年增三人，明年增一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng three were added, and the next year one.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongzheng three more were added, and the next year one more.

sentences.zh: 復增置庫守、內副庫掌八人。

translations.literal: Eight storehouse guards and inner assistant storehouse chiefs were again added.
translations.idiomatic: Eight storehouse guards and inner assistant storehouse chiefs were added again.

sentences.zh: 尋又改為庫掌、副庫掌各十有二人，砲作庫掌、副庫掌各一人。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward these were changed to twelve storehouse chiefs and twelve assistant storehouse chiefs each, and one storehouse chief and one assistant for the gunpowder workshop.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the posts were reorganized as twelve storehouse chiefs and twelve assistant chiefs, with one chief and one assistant for the gunpowder workshop.

sentences.zh: 八品催總一人，雍正四年增。

translations.literal: One supervising chief of rank 8, added in the fourth year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: One rank-8 supervising chief was added in the fourth year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 無品級。

translations.literal: Without official rank.
translations.idiomatic: The post carried no official rank.

sentences.zh: 催總一人，復於領催內增委署三人。

translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, following the precedent of the Imperial Stud, the director quota was fixed at two; grand ministers were still selected to oversee park affairs.

sentences.zh: 十六年，增置樂善園、永安寺八品催總各一人，十七年增樂善園一人。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year one rank-8 supervising clerk each was added for Leshan Garden and Yong'an Temple; in the seventeenth year one more was added for Leshan Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year one supervising clerk of rank 8 was added for Leshan Garden and one for Yong'an Temple; in the seventeenth year one more was added for Leshan Garden.

sentences.zh: 樂善園無品級副總領二人，明年增一人。

translations.literal: Leshan Garden had two deputy chiefs without rank; the following year one was added.
translations.idiomatic: Leshan Garden had two deputy chiefs without official rank; the following year one more was added.

sentences.zh: 南苑委署催總一人。

translations.literal: One acting Southern Park supervising clerk.
translations.idiomatic: There was one acting Southern Park supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 原置一人。

translations.literal: Originally one had been placed.
translations.idiomatic: Originally one had been appointed.

sentences.zh: 明年復增一人。

translations.literal: The following year one more was added.
translations.idiomatic: The following year one more was added.

sentences.zh: 分隸三旗。

translations.literal: Divided among the Three Banners.
translations.idiomatic: They were divided among the Three Banners.

sentences.zh: 是歲依各行宮園囿例，改瀛台、永安寺等處催總為總領，副催總為副總領。

translations.literal: That year, following the precedent of the various traveling palaces and gardens, supervising clerks at Yingtai, Yong'an Temple, and other sites were changed to chiefs, and deputy supervising clerks to deputy chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: That year, following the precedent of the various traveling palaces and gardens, the supervising clerks at Yingtai, Yong'an Temple, and other sites were renamed chiefs, and the deputy supervising clerks were renamed deputy chiefs.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，復改總領曰苑丞，副總領曰苑副，催總曰催長。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year chiefs were again changed to garden directors, deputy chiefs to deputy garden directors, and supervising chiefs to supervising clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the title of chief was changed back to garden director, deputy chief to deputy garden director, and supervising chief to supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，兼轄正覺寺，置苑副一人，令萬壽寺、倚虹堂苑丞分司之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Zhengjue Temple was taken under concurrent jurisdiction; one deputy garden director was placed, and the garden directors of Wanshou Temple and Yihong Hall were ordered to administer it in separate sessions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Zhengjue Temple was placed under concurrent jurisdiction; one deputy garden director was appointed, and the garden directors of Wanshou Temple and Yihong Hall were ordered to administer it in turn.

sentences.zh: 並令闡福寺苑丞兼管宏仁、仁壽二寺，置委署苑副二人。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that the Chanfu Temple garden director should concurrently manage Hongren and Renshou temples, and two acting deputy garden directors were placed.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanfu Temple garden director was also ordered to oversee Hongren and Renshou temples, and two acting deputy garden directors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 積水潭置苑副、委署苑副各二人。

translations.literal: At Jishuitan two deputy garden directors and two acting deputy garden directors were placed.
translations.idiomatic: At Jishuitan two deputy garden directors and two acting deputy garden directors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 是歲省各處委署苑副，酌留南苑三處行宮二人。

translations.literal: That year acting deputy garden directors at various places were abolished, and after weighing the need two were retained at the three traveling palaces of the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: That year the acting deputy garden directors at various posts were abolished; after review, two were kept for the three Southern Park traveling palaces.

sentences.zh: 析置瀛台、永安寺、樂善園及河道四人，並給八品職銜。

translations.literal: Four posts were split out and placed for Yingtai, Yong'an Temple, Leshan Garden, and the waterways, all given rank-8 designations.
translations.idiomatic: Four posts were created for Yingtai, Yong'an Temple, Leshan Garden, and the waterways, all with rank-8 designations.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，極樂世界、萬佛樓建成，置委署苑副一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the Blissful World and the Ten Thousand Buddhas Tower were completed, and one acting deputy garden director was placed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the Blissful World and the Ten Thousand Buddhas Tower were completed, and one acting deputy garden director was appointed.

sentences.zh: 明年，定奉宸苑苑丞品秩。

translations.literal: The following year the rank of Imperial Parks Department garden directors was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the rank of garden directors in the Imperial Parks Department was fixed.

sentences.zh: 先是苑丞秩八品，與各園庭體制不一，至是俱給六品虛銜。

translations.literal: Previously garden directors had held rank 8, inconsistent with the organization of the various gardens and halls; at this time all were given nominal rank-6 designations.
translations.idiomatic: Garden directors had previously held rank 8, which did not match the organization of the various gardens and halls; now all received nominal rank-6 designations.

sentences.zh: 仍食八品原俸。

translations.literal: They still received their original rank-8 salary.
translations.idiomatic: They continued to draw their original salaries at rank 8.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，復定南苑苑丞品秩，食俸同上。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the rank of Southern Park garden directors was again fixed, with salary provisions the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year the rank of Southern Park garden directors was again fixed, with the same salary provisions as above.

sentences.zh: 改三旗八品催長三人為苑丞，副催長為苑副。

translations.literal: Three rank-8 supervising clerks of the Three Banners were changed to garden directors, and assistant supervising clerks to deputy garden directors.
translations.idiomatic: Three rank-8 supervising clerks of the Three Banners were redesignated as garden directors, and assistant supervising clerks as deputy garden directors.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，置釣魚台苑丞、苑副各一人，新挖旱河、徬座、蓮花池、河泡、岔河並隸之。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year one garden director and one deputy garden director were placed for Diaoyutai; the newly dug dry canal, embankment seats, Lotus Pond, river pools, and branch channels were all placed under them.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year one garden director and one deputy garden director were appointed for Diaoyutai; the newly dug dry canal, embankment seats, Lotus Pond, river pools, and branch channels all came under their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，南苑、團河新行宮告成，省新舊各行宮苑丞一人、苑副二人、委署苑副一人，置為本園額缺。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year the new traveling palaces of the Southern Park and Tuanhe were completed; one garden director, two deputy garden directors, and one acting deputy garden director were abolished from the old and new traveling palaces and established as fixed posts of the main gardens.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year the new Southern Park and Tuanhe traveling palaces were completed; one garden director, two deputy garden directors, and one acting deputy garden director were cut from the old and new traveling palaces and reassigned as fixed posts for the main gardens.

sentences.zh: 新舊各行宮原置苑丞二人，苑副、委署苑副各四人，南苑行宮苑副三人。

translations.literal: For the old and new traveling palaces there had originally been two garden directors placed, four deputy garden directors and four acting deputy garden directors, and three Southern Park traveling-palace deputy garden directors.
translations.idiomatic: The old and new traveling palaces had originally had two garden directors, four deputy garden directors, four acting deputy garden directors, and three deputy garden directors for the Southern Park traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，省樂善園苑丞一人入團河行宮。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year one Leshan Garden garden director was abolished and transferred to the Tuanhe traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year one garden director was cut from Leshan Garden and reassigned to the Tuanhe traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年，定奉宸苑苑丞食六品俸、苑副食九品俸，各二人，餘悉如故。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing it was fixed that Imperial Parks Department garden directors should receive rank-6 salary and deputy garden directors rank-9 salary, two of each; all else remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Jiaqing reign it was fixed that Imperial Parks Department garden directors should draw rank-6 salaries and deputy garden directors rank-9 salaries, two of each; all else remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 九年，復省樂善園苑丞、苑副額缺，析置中海苑丞、苑副，倚虹堂苑丞，釣魚台苑副，北海及長河委署苑副各一人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Leshan Garden garden-director and deputy-garden-director quota posts were again abolished; garden directors and deputy garden directors were split out for Central Sea, a Yihong Hall garden director was placed, a Diaoyutai deputy garden director, and one acting deputy garden director each for North Sea and Long River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the garden-director and deputy-garden-director posts at Leshan Garden were again abolished; posts were created for a Central Sea garden director and deputy garden director, a Yihong Hall garden director, a Diaoyutai deputy garden director, and one acting deputy garden director each for North Sea and Long River.

sentences.zh: 十二年，復析三海等處苑丞、苑副各二人，令司天壇齋宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year two garden directors and two deputy garden directors were again split out from the Three Seas and other sites and ordered to administer the Temple of Heaven fasting palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year two garden directors and two deputy garden directors were again drawn from the Three Seas and other sites and assigned to manage the Temple of Heaven fasting palace.

sentences.zh: 故事，齋宮隸太常寺，歸奉祀壇戶典守。

translations.literal: By precedent the fasting palace was subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was maintained under the sacrificial-altar household custodians.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the fasting palace had been administered by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and maintained by the sacrificial-altar household custodians.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，置八品催總治其事。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng reign one rank-8 supervising chief was placed to manage the matter.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign one rank-8 supervising chief had been appointed to manage it.

sentences.zh: 至是，額置苑丞各官，定苑丞食六品俸一人。

translations.literal: At this time quota posts for garden directors and other officials were established; one garden director receiving rank-6 salary was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time fixed posts for garden directors and related officials were established, including one garden director drawing a rank-6 salary.

sentences.zh: 以郎中、員外郎兼領之。

translations.literal: Directors and vice directors concurrently led it.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau directors and vice directors served concurrently as superintendents.

sentences.zh: 盛京內務府總管大臣一人。

translations.literal: One superintendent grand minister of the Mukden Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: There was one superintendent grand minister of the Mukden Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 盛京將軍兼。

translations.literal: Concurrently held by the Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: The post was held concurrently by the Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 後改東三省總督。

translations.literal: Later changed to the governor-general of the Three Eastern Provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was held by the governor-general of the Three Eastern Provinces.

sentences.zh: 佐領，驍騎校，各三人。

translations.literal: Company commandants and banner cavalry captains, three each.
translations.idiomatic: There were three company commandants and three banner cavalry captains.

sentences.zh: 堂主事，委署主事，各一人。

translations.literal: One bureau secretary and one acting secretary each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one bureau secretary and one acting secretary.

sentences.zh: 廣儲司司庫三人，庫使十有六人。

translations.literal: Three storehouse superintendents of the Bureau of General Storage and sixteen storehouse attendants.
translations.idiomatic: General Storage had three storehouse superintendents and sixteen storehouse attendants.

sentences.zh: 會稽、掌禮、都虞、營造四司，及文溯閣九品催長，無品級催長，各一人。

translations.literal: For the four bureaus—Accounts, Ceremonies, Household Affairs, and Construction—and for the Wensu Pavilion rank-9 supervising clerk and supervising clerk without rank, one each.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts, Ceremonies, Household Affairs, and Construction each had one supervising clerk; the Wensu Pavilion had one rank-9 supervising clerk and one without official rank.

sentences.zh: 織造庫催長，內管領處內管領，六品虛銜。

translations.literal: One weaving-storehouse supervising clerk and one interior steward of the Interior Steward Office, with nominal rank 6.
translations.idiomatic: There was one weaving-storehouse supervising clerk and one interior steward in the Interior Steward Office, both bearing nominal rank 6.

sentences.zh: 倉領長，無品級。

translations.literal: One granary superintendent chief, without official rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one granary superintendent chief without official rank.

sentences.zh: 各一人。

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: One of each was appointed.

sentences.zh: 牧掌，隸都虞司。

translations.literal: Herd stewards, subordinate to the Household Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Herd stewards were subordinate to the Household Affairs Bureau.

sentences.zh: 倉長，隸內管領處。

translations.literal: Granary chiefs, subordinate to the Interior Steward Office.
translations.idiomatic: Granary chiefs were subordinate to the Interior Steward Office.

sentences.zh: 各三人。

translations.literal: Three each.
translations.idiomatic: There were three of each.

sentences.zh: 俱無品級。

translations.literal: All without official rank.
translations.idiomatic: All held no official rank.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式十有五人。

translations.literal: Fifteen clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were fifteen clerks.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，盛京包衣三旗置佐領三人，簡一人掌關防，並置司庫三人，乾隆十九年省一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi three company commandants were placed for the Mukden Personal-Bond Three Banners, one selected to hold the official seal; three storehouse superintendents were also placed; in the nineteenth year of Qianlong one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Shunzhi reign three company commandants were appointed for the Mukden Personal-Bond Three Banners, one of whom held the official seal; three storehouse superintendents were also appointed; in the nineteenth year of Qianlong one was cut.

sentences.zh: 四十二年增一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year one more was added.

sentences.zh: 及催總、筆帖式各官。

translations.literal: And supervising chiefs, clerks, and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising chiefs, clerks, and related officials were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 尋置庫使十人。

translations.literal: Soon ten storehouse attendants were placed.
translations.idiomatic: Ten storehouse attendants were soon appointed.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年增一人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Qianlong reign one more was added.

sentences.zh: 康熙十七年，置領催下驍騎校一人。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Kangxi one banner cavalry captain under the chief supervising clerk was placed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of the Kangxi reign one banner cavalry captain was appointed under the chief supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年，置總管。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong the superintendent was placed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of the Qianlong reign a superintendent was appointed.

sentences.zh: 明年，置堂主事一人。

translations.literal: The following year one bureau secretary was placed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year one bureau secretary was appointed.

sentences.zh: 司庫內改置。

translations.literal: Transferred from among the storehouse superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: The post was filled by transfer from among the storehouse superintendents.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，改催總為催長。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year supervising chiefs were changed to supervising clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the title of supervising chief was changed to supervising clerk.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，定各催長員數。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the quotas of the various supervising clerks were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the quotas for the various supervising clerks were fixed.

sentences.zh: 如前所列。

translations.literal: As listed above.
translations.idiomatic: As listed above.

sentences.zh: 增置內管領、委署主事筆帖式內改置。

translations.literal: Interior stewards and acting secretaries were added, transferred from among the clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Interior stewards and acting secretaries were added, appointed by transfer from among the clerks.

sentences.zh: 各一人。

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: One of each was appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，文溯閣建成，置九品催長，無品級催長，各一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year the Wensu Pavilion was completed; one rank-9 supervising clerk and one supervising clerk without rank were placed.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year the Wensu Pavilion was completed; one rank-9 supervising clerk and one without official rank were appointed.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，省主事各官。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu the secretary posts and other officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of the Guangxu reign the secretaries and related officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 宦官四品總管太監銜曰宮殿監督領侍。

translations.literal: For eunuchs, the rank-4 chief superintendent eunuch title was called Palace Supervisor Attendant-in-Charge.
translations.idiomatic: For eunuchs, the rank-4 chief superintendent bore the title Palace Supervisor Attendant-in-Charge.

sentences.zh: 五品總管銜曰宮殿監正侍。

translations.literal: The rank-5 chief superintendent title was called Palace Bureau Chief Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The rank-5 chief superintendent bore the title Palace Bureau Chief Attendant.

sentences.zh: 亦有以七品執守侍充者。

translations.literal: Some were also filled by Attendants-in-Charge of rank 7.
translations.idiomatic: Some posts were also filled by Attendants-in-Charge of rank 7.

sentences.zh: 六品副總管銜曰宮殿監副侍。

translations.literal: The rank-6 deputy chief superintendent title was called Palace Bureau Deputy Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The rank-6 deputy chief superintendent bore the title Palace Bureau Deputy Attendant.

sentences.zh: 亦有系執守侍銜者。

translations.literal: Some also held the Attendant-in-Charge designation.
translations.idiomatic: Some also held the Attendant-in-Charge designation.

sentences.zh: 首領太監銜二：七品曰執守侍，八品曰侍監。

translations.literal: Chief eunuch designations were two: rank 7 was Attendant-in-Charge, rank 8 was Attendant Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Chief eunuchs had two designations: rank 7 Attendant-in-Charge and rank 8 Attendant Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 又有副首領，八品侍監充。

translations.literal: There were also deputy chiefs, filled by Attendant Supervisors of rank 8.
translations.idiomatic: There were also deputy chiefs, filled by rank-8 Attendant Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 亦有無品級者。

translations.literal: Some also held no official rank.
translations.idiomatic: Some held no official rank.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式。

translations.literal: Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 八品侍監充。

translations.literal: Filled by Attendant Supervisors of rank 8.
translations.idiomatic: They were filled by rank-8 Attendant Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 敬事房置。

translations.literal: Placed by the Office of Respectful Service.
translations.idiomatic: These posts were established by the Office of Respectful Service.

sentences.zh: 自四品至八品凡五等。

translations.literal: From rank 4 to rank 8 there were five grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: From rank 4 to rank 8 there were five grades in all.

sentences.zh: 陞遷降調，由內府移咨吏部。

translations.literal: Promotions, demotions, and transfers were handled by the inner department sending consultation to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions, demotions, and transfers were handled when the inner department submitted consultation to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 敬事房，兼讀清字書房，漢字、蒙字書房，總管三人。

translations.literal: The Office of Respectful Service, also overseeing the Manchu Script Study, Chinese Script Study, and Mongol Script Study, had three chief superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Respectful Service, which also oversaw the Manchu, Chinese, and Mongol script studies, had three chief superintendents.

sentences.zh: 宮殿監督領侍一人。

translations.literal: One Palace Supervisor Attendant-in-Charge.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Palace Supervisor Attendant-in-Charge.

sentences.zh: 宮殿監正侍二人。

translations.literal: Two Palace Bureau Chief Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Palace Bureau Chief Attendants.

sentences.zh: 宮殿監副侍總管六人。

translations.literal: Six chief superintendents with the Palace Bureau Deputy Attendant designation.
translations.idiomatic: Six chief superintendents bore the Palace Bureau Deputy Attendant designation.

sentences.zh: 委署總管無定額，執守侍充。

translations.literal: Acting chief superintendents had no fixed quota and were filled by Attendants-in-Charge.
translations.idiomatic: Acting chief superintendents had no fixed quota and were filled by Attendants-in-Charge.

sentences.zh: 專司遵奉諭旨，承應宮內事務與其禮節，收覈外庫錢糧，甄別調補內監，並巡察各門啟閉、火燭關防。

translations.literal: They exclusively administered compliance with imperial instructions, attended to inner-palace affairs and their ceremonial protocols, collected and verified outer-storehouse grain and funds, screened and reassigned inner eunuchs, and inspected the opening and closing of the various gates, lamps and candles, and security seals.
translations.idiomatic: They carried out imperial instructions, managed inner-palace affairs and ceremonial protocol, collected and verified grain and funds from the outer storehouses, screened and reassigned palace eunuchs, and inspected gate openings and closings, lamps and candles, and security seals.

sentences.zh: 執守侍、首領、侍監、筆帖式各二人，專司掌案辦事，承行內府文移，並司巡防坐更。

translations.literal: Two Attendants-in-Charge, two chiefs, two Attendant Supervisors, and two clerks each, exclusively managing case records and office work, transmitting inner-department documents, and overseeing patrol security and night-watch duty.
translations.idiomatic: Two Attendants-in-Charge, two chiefs, two Attendant Supervisors, and two clerks managed case records, transmitted inner-department documents, and oversaw patrol security and night-watch duty.

sentences.zh: 乾清宮。

translations.literal: Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 首領四人，執守侍、侍監各二人。

translations.literal: Four chiefs, two Attendants-in-Charge and two Attendant Supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: There were four chiefs—two Attendants-in-Charge and two Attendant Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 專司供奉實錄、聖訓，江山社稷殿香燭，收貯賞用器物，並司陳設氾埽，御前坐更。

translations.literal: They exclusively tended the Veritable Records and Sacred Instructions, incense and candles at the Altar of Land and Grain Hall, stored award-use utensils, and managed furnishings and cleaning and imperial night-watch duty.
translations.idiomatic: They tended the Veritable Records and Sacred Instructions, maintained incense and candles at the Altar of Land and Grain Hall, stored award utensils, managed furnishings and cleaning, and stood night watch before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 後省二人。

translations.literal: Later two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later two posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 正首領，執守侍充。

translations.literal: The chief head was filled by an Attendant-in-Charge.
translations.idiomatic: The senior chief was an Attendant-in-Charge.

sentences.zh: 副首領，侍監充。

translations.literal: The deputy chief was filled by an Attendant Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy chief was an Attendant Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 乾清門。

translations.literal: Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 侍監首領二人。

translations.literal: Two Attendant Supervisor chiefs.

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, the number of eunuch chiefs for princes and princesses was fixed, and rank-8 designations were conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year, the number of eunuch chiefs for princes and princesses was fixed, and rank-8 designations were conferred.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間增親王首領秩七品。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing reign the chief for Princes of the First Rank was raised to rank 7.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing reign the chief for Princes of the First Rank was raised to rank 7.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年，賞慶郡王七品太監三人，儀親王、成親王、定親王增置八品太監一人，不為恆制。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing, three rank-7 eunuchs were bestowed on Prince Qing, and one rank-8 eunuch each was added for Prince Yi, Prince Cheng, and Prince Ding; these were not fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Jiaqing reign, three rank-7 eunuchs were bestowed on Prince Qing, and one rank-8 eunuch each was added for Prince Yi, Prince Cheng, and Prince Ding; these were not standing regulations.
